 import os
 from datetime import date, timedelta
 from pathlib import Path
 
 import pandas as pd
 import requests
 from dotenv import load_dotenv
 
 
 GUARDIAN_API_URL = "https://content.guardianapis.com"
 SECTIONS = ("business", "economics")
 START_DATE = date(2020, 1, 1)
 MAX_ARTICLES = 5_000
 COLUMNS = ["url", "title", "section", "date", "body"]
 PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
 OUTPUT_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "articles.parquet"
 
 
 def fetch_articles(
     api_key: str,
     section: str,
     from_date: date,
     session: requests.Session | None = None,
 ) -> list[dict]:
     http = session or requests.Session()
     articles: list[dict] = []
     page = 1
 
     while len(articles) < MAX_ARTICLES:
         response = http.get(
             f"{GUARDIAN_API_URL}/{section}",
             params={
                 "api-key": api_key,
                 "from-date": from_date.isoformat(),
                 "to-date": date.today().isoformat(),
                 "show-fields": "bodyText",
                 "page-size": 200,
                 "page": page,
                 "order-by": "oldest",
             },
             timeout=30,
         )
         response.raise_for_status()
         payload = response.json()["response"]
         for item in payload["results"]:
             fields = item.get("fields") or {}
             articles.append(
                 {
                     "url": item["webUrl"],
                     "title": item["webTitle"],
                     "section": item["sectionName"],
                     "date": item["webPublicationDate"],
                     "body": fields.get("bodyText", ""),
                 }
             )
             if len(articles) >= MAX_ARTICLES:
                 break
 
         if page >= payload["pages"]:
             break
         page += 1
 
     return articles
 
 
 def load_existing(output_path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
     if not output_path.exists():
         return pd.DataFrame(columns=COLUMNS)
     return pd.read_parquet(output_path)
 
 
 def collect_articles(
     output_path: Path = OUTPUT_PATH,
     session: requests.Session | None = None,
 ) -> pd.DataFrame:
     load_dotenv()
     api_key = os.getenv("GUARDIAN_API_KEY")
     if not api_key:
         raise RuntimeError("GUARDIAN_API_KEY is not set")
 
     existing = load_existing(output_path)
     if existing.empty:
         from_date = START_DATE
     else:
         existing_dates = pd.to_datetime(existing["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce")
         latest = existing_dates.max()
         if pd.isna(latest):
             from_date = START_DATE
         else:
             from_date = max(START_DATE, (latest.date() - timedelta(days=1)))
 
     fetched: list[dict] = []
     for section in SECTIONS:
         remaining = MAX_ARTICLES - len(existing)
         if remaining <= 0:
             break
         fetched.extend(fetch_articles(api_key, section, from_date, session)[:remaining])
 
     combined = pd.concat(
         [existing, pd.DataFrame(fetched, columns=COLUMNS)],
         ignore_index=True,
     )
     combined = combined.drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="last")
     combined = combined.head(MAX_ARTICLES)
     combined["date"] = pd.to_datetime(combined["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce")
 
     output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
     combined.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)
     return combined

 OUTPUT_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "articles.parquet"
 
 
 def fetch_articles(
     api_key: str,
     section: str,
     from_date: date,
     session: requests.Session | None = None,
     max_articles: int = MAX_ARTICLES,
     to_date: date | None = None,
     pages_fetched: list[int] | None = None,
     tag: str = "",
 ) -> list[dict]:
     http = session or requests.Session()
     articles: list[dict] = []
     page = 1
 
     while len(articles) < max_articles:
         endpoint = f"{GUARDIAN_API_URL}/search"
         params = {
             "api-key": api_key,
             "section": section,
             "from-date": from_date.isoformat(),
             "to-date": (to_date or date.today()).isoformat(),
             "show-fields": "bodyText",
             "page-size": 200,
             "page": page,
             "order-by": "oldest",
         }
         if tag:
             params["tag"] = tag
 
         try:
             response = http.get(
                 endpoint,
                 params=params,
                 timeout=30,
             )
             response.raise_for_status()
         except requests.HTTPError as error:
             error_response = getattr(error, "response", None)
             response_url = getattr(error_response, "url", None) or endpoint
             status_code = getattr(error_response, "status_code", None)
             path = urlparse(response_url).path or "/search"
             if status_code is None:
                 status_code = getattr(response, "status_code", "unknown")
             print(f"Guardian API HTTP {status_code}: {path}")
             break
         payload = response.json()["response"]
         if pages_fetched is not None:
             pages_fetched[0] += 1
         for item in payload["results"]:
             fields = item.get("fields") or {}
             articles.append(
                 {
                     "url": item["webUrl"],
                     "title": item["webTitle"],
                     "section": item["sectionName"],
                     "date": item["webPublicationDate"],
                     "body": fields.get("bodyText", ""),
                 }
             )
             if len(articles) >= max_articles:
                 break
 
         if page >= payload["pages"]:
             break
         page += 1
 
     return articles
 
 
 def load_existing(output_path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
     if not output_path.exists():
         return pd.DataFrame(columns=COLUMNS)
     return pd.read_parquet(output_path)
 
 
 def month_starts(start: date, end: date):
     current = date(start.year, start.month, 1)
     while current <= end:
         yield current
         if current.month == 12:
             current = date(current.year + 1, 1, 1)
         else:
             current = date(current.year, current.month + 1, 1)
 
 
 def month_end(month: date, end: date) -> date:
     if month.month == 12:
         next_month = date(month.year + 1, 1, 1)
     else:
         next_month = date(month.year, month.month + 1, 1)
     last_day = next_month.fromordinal(next_month.toordinal() - 1)
     return min(last_day, end)
 
 
 def print_final_summary(data: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
     if data.empty:
         print("Final summary: 0 articles; date range: N/A")
         print("Sections: business=0, economics=0")
         return
 
     dates = pd.to_datetime(data["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce").dropna()
     if dates.empty:
         date_range = "N/A"
     else:
         date_range = f"{dates.min().date()} to {dates.max().date()}"
 
     sections = data["section"].fillna("").str.lower()
     business_count = sections.str.contains("business", regex=False).sum()
     economics_count = sections.str.contains("economics", regex=False).sum()
     print(f"Final summary: {len(data)} articles; date range: {date_range}")
     print(
         f"Sections: business={business_count}, economics={economics_count}"
     )
 
 
 def collect_articles(
     output_path: Path = OUTPUT_PATH,
     session: requests.Session | None = None,
     max_articles: int = MAX_ARTICLES,
     per_month: int = 80,
     tag: str = "",
 ) -> pd.DataFrame:
     load_dotenv()
     api_key = os.getenv("GUARDIAN_API_KEY")
     if not api_key:
         raise RuntimeError("GUARDIAN_API_KEY is not set")
 
     if max_articles < 1:
         raise ValueError("max_articles must be at least 1")
     if per_month < 1:
         raise ValueError("per_month must be at least 1")
 
     combined = load_existing(output_path)
     combined["date"] = pd.to_datetime(combined["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce")
     pages_fetched = [0]
     today = date.today()
     output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 
     for month in month_starts(START_DATE, today):
         if len(combined) >= max_articles:
             break
 
         month_dates = pd.to_datetime(combined["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce")
         in_month = (
             (month_dates.dt.year == month.year)
             & (month_dates.dt.month == month.month)
         )
         month_count = int(in_month.sum())
         remaining_in_month = per_month - month_count
         if remaining_in_month <= 0:
             continue
 
         remaining_total = max_articles - len(combined)
         remaining = min(remaining_in_month, remaining_total)
         fetched: list[dict] = []
         quotas = [
             (remaining + len(SECTIONS) - index - 1) // len(SECTIONS)
             for index in range(len(SECTIONS))
         ]
 
         end = month_end(month, today)
         for section, quota in zip(SECTIONS, quotas):
             if quota <= 0:
                 continue
             fetched.extend(
                 fetch_articles(
                     api_key,
                     section,
                     month,
                     session,
                     quota,
                     end,
                     pages_fetched,
                     tag,
                 )
             )
 
         if fetched:
             combined = pd.concat(
                 [combined, pd.DataFrame(fetched, columns=COLUMNS)],
                 ignore_index=True,
             )
         combined = combined.drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="last")
         combined["date"] = pd.to_datetime(combined["date"], utc=True, errors="coerce")
         combined = combined.head(max_articles)
         combined.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)
         print(
             f"Pages fetched: {pages_fetched[0]}; "
             f"Articles saved so far: {len(combined)}"
         )
 
     combined.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)
     print_final_summary(combined)
     return combined

     parser.add_argument("--max-articles", type=int, default=MAX_ARTICLES)

     if not parquet_files:
         return 0, None, None

     minimum: str | None = None
     maximum: str | None = None
     for batch in dataset.scanner(
         columns=["SQLDATE"],

     ).to_batches():

         if dates.empty:

 def validate_archive(content: bytes) -> tuple[zipfile.ZipFile, str]:
     archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content))
     members = [name for name in archive.namelist() if not name.endswith("/")]
     if len(members) != 1:
         archive.close()
         raise ValueError("archive must contain exactly one CSV file")
 
     try:
         row_count = 0
         with archive.open(members[0]) as csv_file:
             text_file = io.TextIOWrapper(csv_file, encoding="utf-8")
             for row_count, row in enumerate(
                 csv.reader(text_file, delimiter="\t"),
                 start=1,
             ):
                 if len(row) != 61:
                     raise ValueError(
                         f"CSV row {row_count} has {len(row)} columns; expected 61"
                     )
     except (UnicodeDecodeError, csv.Error) as error:
         archive.close()
         raise ValueError("CSV file is not valid UTF-8 tab-separated data") from error
     except ValueError:
         archive.close()
         raise
     if row_count == 0:
         archive.close()
         raise ValueError("CSV file is empty")
     return archive, members[0]
 
 
 def write_chunk(
     chunk: pd.DataFrame,
     events_dir: Path,
     seen_ids: set[str],
     basename: str,
     chunk_number: int,
 ) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[str]]:
     selected = chunk.iloc[:, COLUMN_INDEXES].copy()
     selected.columns = COLUMN_NAMES
     selected["GLOBALEVENTID"] = selected["GLOBALEVENTID"].astype("string")
     selected = selected.drop_duplicates(subset="GLOBALEVENTID", keep="first")
     selected = selected.loc[
         ~selected["GLOBALEVENTID"].isin(seen_ids)
     ].copy()
     if selected.empty:
         return 0, [], []
 
     dates = pd.to_datetime(
         selected["SQLDATE"].astype("string"),
         format="%Y%m%d",
         errors="coerce",
     )
     date_values = dates.dropna()
     date_min = date_values.min().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if not date_values.empty else None
     date_max = date_values.max().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if not date_values.empty else None
     selected["year"] = dates.dt.strftime("%Y").fillna("unknown")
     selected["month"] = dates.dt.strftime("%m").fillna("unknown")
 
     table = pa.Table.from_pandas(selected, preserve_index=False)
     ds.write_dataset(
         table,
         base_dir=events_dir,
         format="parquet",
         partitioning=["year", "month"],
         partitioning_flavor="hive",
         basename_template=f"{basename}-{chunk_number}-{{i}}.parquet",
         existing_data_behavior="overwrite_or_ignore",
     )

         raise ValueError("max_files must be at least 1")

         step_days,

                 f"Progress: {index}/{len(pending)} new files; "
                 f"downloaded={files_downloaded}, skipped={files_skipped}, rows={total_rows}"
             )

         basename = f"{timestamp}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

             archive, member = validate_archive(response.content)
         except (ValueError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
             print(f"Warning: skipped {timestamp}; invalid archive: {error}")
             files_skipped += 1
             mark_processed(processed_path, timestamp)
             processed.add(timestamp)
             print(
                 f"Progress: {index}/{len(pending)} new files; "
                 f"downloaded={files_downloaded}, skipped={files_skipped}, rows={total_rows}"
             )
             continue
 
         new_rows = 0
         file_min: str | None = None
         file_max: str | None = None
         try:
             with archive, archive.open(member) as csv_file:
                 reader = pd.read_csv(
                     csv_file,
                     sep="\t",
                     header=None,
                     dtype="string",
                     chunksize=CHUNK_SIZE,
                 )

                     if chunk.shape[1] != 61:

                             f"CSV chunk has {chunk.shape[1]} columns; expected 61"
                         )
                     rows, minima, maxima = write_chunk(
                         chunk,
                         events_dir,
                         seen_ids,
                         basename,
                         chunk_number,
                     )
                     new_rows += rows
                     if minima:
                         file_min = min(file_min, minima[0]) if file_min else minima[0]
                     if maxima:
                         file_max = max(file_max, maxima[0]) if file_max else maxima[0]
         except (pd.errors.ParserError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
             for partial_file in events_dir.rglob(f"{basename}-*.parquet"):
                 partial_file.unlink()
             print(f"Warning: skipped {timestamp}; invalid CSV: {error}")
             files_skipped += 1
             mark_processed(processed_path, timestamp)
             processed.add(timestamp)
             print(
                 f"Progress: {index}/{len(pending)} new files; "
                 f"downloaded={files_downloaded}, skipped={files_skipped}, rows={total_rows}"
             )
             continue
 
         total_rows += new_rows
         if file_min:
             minimum_date = min(minimum_date, file_min) if minimum_date else file_min
         if file_max:
             maximum_date = max(maximum_date, file_max) if maximum_date else file_max
         mark_processed(processed_path, timestamp)
         processed.add(timestamp)

             f"Progress: {index}/{len(pending)} new files; "
             f"downloaded={files_downloaded}, skipped={files_skipped}, rows={total_rows}"
